title: A Study of the Efficacy and Safety of ETC-1002 in Participants With Statin Intolerance

sections.abstract:
This study will assess the Low-Density Lipoprotein-Cholesterol (LDL-C) lowering efficacy and safety of ETC-1002 versus placebo in participants with hypercholesterolemia and a history of statin intolerance.

Posted outcomes: Percent Change From Baseline to Week 8 in Calculated Low-Density Lipoprotein-Cholesterol (LDL-C). timeframe=Baseline; 8 weeks. ETC-1002=-32.0 (±1.93); Placebo=-3.3 (±2.69). p=<0.0001
